models.name: collection
models.title: Collection
models.description: A set of Documents published together: a site, a blog, a docs tree, a changelog or a help centre, with a slug and a public flag that publishes its published Documents.

models.name: deal
models.title: Deal
models.description: A potential sale to an Organization or a Person, tracked through a Pipeline, with an amount, a probability and an expected close.

models.name: document
models.title: Document
models.description: One piece of content in a Collection: a page, a post, a docs article, a changelog entry or a help article, in Markdown, with a status from draft to published, authors, SEO metadata and an optional parent for hierarchies.

models.name: event
models.title: Event
models.description: A scheduled block of time: a meeting, a call, an appointment, a reminder.

models.name: file
models.title: File
models.description: Stored or referenced binary content with a name and a type.

models.name: identity
models.title: Identity
models.description: How a principal authenticates: a provider's stable subject bound to a Member (an operator) or a Person (an end user), with the asserted email and the kinds of factor used.

models.name: import_run
models.title: Import run
models.description: One execution of an importer: which importer, in which mode, with what outcome and per-model counts.

models.name: invoice
models.title: Invoice
models.description: A statement of money owed for goods or services: receivable when we issued it, payable when we received it (a bill).

models.name: member
models.title: Member
models.description: An operator of the workspace: a person on the team, an agent or a service, with roles.

models.name: message
models.title: Message
models.description: One message on a channel: an email, a chat message, an SMS, a call record, with sender, recipients, body and the records it is about.

models.name: note
models.title: Note
models.description: Free text about one or more records: an internal note, a comment, a meeting summary.

models.name: organization
models.title: Organization
models.description: A company, nonprofit, government body or household: a customer, a vendor, a partner or an account.

models.name: payment
models.title: Payment
models.description: Money that moved against invoices: a customer paying us (receivable), us paying a vendor (payable), or a refund of either.

models.name: person
models.title: Person
models.description: A human being: a customer, a contact, an employee, or an end user of the product.

models.name: pipeline
models.title: Pipeline
models.description: An ordered set of stages that Deals move through, each mapped to one of the standard categories open, won or lost.

models.name: policy
models.title: Policy
models.description: A rule: which principals may do which actions on which model, narrowed by a filter in the query grammar.

models.name: price
models.title: Price
models.description: An amount at which a Product is sold, once or on a recurring interval.

models.name: product
models.title: Product
models.description: A thing the business sells or buys: a good, a service or a digital item.

models.name: project
models.title: Project
models.description: A container of work with a lifecycle: planned, active, paused, done or cancelled.

models.name: share
models.title: Share
models.description: A grant of read, and optionally comment, access to records, by ids or by filter, to someone outside the workspace: a link, an email, another workspace or the public.

models.name: subscription
models.title: Subscription
models.description: A recurring agreement to bill (receivable) or be billed (payable) for Prices, period after period.

models.name: tag
models.title: Tag
models.description: A label that works the same on every record: a namespaced slug with a display name, a colour and a description.

models.name: task
models.title: Task
models.description: A unit of work with a status, a priority, assignees and a due date.

models.name: tax_rate
models.title: Tax rate
models.description: A named tax percentage applied to invoice lines (VAT 20%, GST 5%, a state sales tax), referenced by Products and Invoice lines.

models.name: team
models.title: Team
models.description: A named group of Members that work is assigned to.

models.name: ticket
models.title: Ticket
models.description: A request for help from a Person, owned by the team until it is solved.

models.name: workspace
models.title: Workspace
models.description: The tenant: one company or one person, holding exactly one of these records, its first.

packs.name: core
packs.label: Core
packs.description: The everyday records of a company: people, organizations, teams, projects, tasks, events, notes, messages, files and products. Included in every workspace.

packs.name: system
packs.label: System
packs.description: The accounts, permissions, sharing and labels every workspace has. Included in every workspace.

packs.name: crm
packs.label: CRM
packs.description: Sales pipelines and the deals moving through them.

packs.name: billing
packs.label: Billing
packs.description: Prices, subscriptions, invoices, payments and tax rates.

packs.name: support
packs.label: Support
packs.description: Support tickets; the conversation is Messages about the ticket and internal notes are Notes.

packs.name: content
packs.label: Content
packs.description: Collections and Documents for a site, docs, a blog, a changelog or a help centre.
